mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines (3-month rolling trend), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.8% for three consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.8% for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative earnings outlooks and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (3-month change), or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing supply chain disruptions (indicated by a 3-month decline in industrial production), elevated input costs reduce corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO declines for 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annually signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) growth falls below 50,000 monthly, it indicates a slowing labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS < 50,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals strong economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens economic activity, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
